_comment: Shared TS<->Python parity fixture for the keyed model-catalog merge (spec internal/spec-model-rungs-and-roles-2026-06-09.md Addendum 2). Both ModelRouter.ts (mergeModelCatalog) and primary_bot.py (merge_model_catalog) must resolve each scenario's five roles to the SAME primary model. The expected primaries below are the contract both sides are pinned to. 'judge' is provider-diversity-constrained: the parity helpers pick the first model in the judge rung whose provider differs from standard's resolved primary (mirrors ModelRouter._resolveJudgeModel), null when none exists. Scenario 5 exercises the legacy tiers->rungs normalization (_normalize_legacy_layer / synthesizeRungsRoles); note the F2 fallbacks asymmetry — Python folds tiers.tierN.fallbacks into the rung cluster and TS does not, so scenario 5 asserts PRIMARIES only (the asymmetric google fallback is never a resolved primary on either side). KEEP IN SYNC: edit this file once; both parity tests read it.

scenarios.name: bare pod — defaults only (Max ships armed)
scenarios._comment: judge rides the default sonnet-class rung [anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6, openai/gpt-4.1, google/gemini-2.5-pro, xai/grok-4]; standard resolves to anthropic, so the provider-diversity constraint picks the first non-anthropic member: openai/gpt-4.1.

scenarios.name: pod overrides standard rung — pod beats default
bot overrides power rung — bot beats pod beats default
pod-only fable cap + max role still resolves from default fable rung
legacy-only bot layer — tiers normalize, legacy wins, defaults fill the rest
scenarios._comment: tier2.fallbacks (google/gemini-2.0-flash) is folded into the synthesized sonnet-class cluster on the Python side only (F2 asymmetry); it is never a resolved primary, so this scenario stays parity-safe. standard -> openai/gpt-4o (legacy beats default sonnet); judge picks the first non-openai member of the synthesized sonnet-class rung (anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6, retained so judge diversity is satisfiable); fast/power/max fall through to the code defaults (max -> claude-fable-5).

scenarios.name: bot empty sonnet-class rung is a no-op — does NOT brick standard
scenarios._comment: An operator-written empty-models override rung must NOT shadow the base/default rung (mergeOneRung / _merge_one_rung): 'explicit config wins wherever it SPEAKS', and an empty models list does not speak. standard still resolves via the default sonnet-class cluster; judge stays provider-diverse against it. The Evolve admin onboarding/checklist surfaces flag this broken-but-defaulted config separately via tierOverrideIsBroken / tier_override_is_broken — but the merge/routing here must keep the bot working (#2561 onboarding semantics).
